integration.description: Built-in integration name, package name or relative adapter module.

extends.description: Configuration file to inherit, resolved from the declaring file.

entry.description: TypeScript entry file, resolved from the declaring configuration.

tsconfig.description: TypeScript configuration file, resolved from the declaring configuration.

outDir.description: Output directory, resolved from the declaring configuration.

extraProperties.description: Policy for undeclared runtime object properties: 'error' reports EXTRA_PROPERTY (default), 'strip' silently deletes them.

onUnsupported.description: How to handle unsupported or partially protected contracts.

strictClass.description: Default validation mode for class-typed contracts: false validates structurally, like an equivalent interface (matching TypeScript's own structural typing); true requires instanceof wherever the compiler can embed a live reference to the class (same file as the validation point). Override per class with @StrictClass()/@StructuralClass().

enforcePrivate.description: Rewrite TypeScript `private` class fields into real ECMAScript `#private` fields (TypeScript's own `private` has no runtime effect; the field stays reflectively public). Fails the build if any field being converted is accessed through bracket notation anywhere in the program, since that pattern has no `#private` equivalent.

enforceReadonly.description: Lock `readonly` class fields against further writes after their first validated assignment, instead of leaving them as an ordinary writable runtime property.

enforceClosedInstances.description: Make class instances non-extensible once construction completes (Object.preventExtensions), so properties not declared on the class cannot be added afterward, string or symbol keys alike. Opt-in: libraries that copy every key of a request body onto `new Dto()` before filtering (e.g. class-transformer with ValidationPipe whitelist) will throw a native TypeError unless configured to write only declared keys (e.g. excludeExtraneousValues with @Expose()).

enforceMutationGuards.description: Wrap arrays that cross a typed boundary in a Proxy so that later mutations (push, splice, index or length writes) of an item that fails the element schema throw a StrictTypeError instead of succeeding silently. Opt-in: adds a Proxy per guarded array and a validation step on every element write.

sourceMap.description: Emit bundle source maps; compiler source maps must also be enabled.

externals.description: External module names required at runtime.

license.description: License output filename, or null to disable it.

assets.description: Assets copied into the output directory.

from.description: Source path or glob, resolved from the declaring configuration.

to.description: Destination relative to outDir; parent escapes are rejected.

coverage.description: Coverage report detail without changing validation rigor.

reportFile.description: Manifest JSON path, resolved from the declaring configuration, or null.
